risk_note: RV2 (ledger). Two fail-closed fixes (orchestrator 2026-10-20 06:3x assignment 2). (1) Daily check: after loading and dropping superseded files, an empty invariant set rejects with DAILY_CHECK_FAILED, logs one failure and writes no daily_balances (B2-02j money round 2 S2). (2) Lock registry: lockBalances appends a random token to the transaction-local setting couli.ledger_lock_tokens at the current (sub)transaction level and records token -> accounts in memory; a caller's ROLLBACK TO SAVEPOINT undoes both the row locks and the setting, RELEASE keeps both; post and reverse read the setting before touching row locks and accept only accounts whose token is still present, otherwise NOT_LOCKED with no write and no re-lock (B2-02f money round 1 S2). The ledger's own savepoints never write the setting, so a rejected post does not invalidate earlier locks. No change to amounts, signs or posting order.
